INFORMATION FOR AUTHORS

Submission Process

The Journal of Physical Sciences Advances (JPSA) welcomes scholarly contributions within its areas of interest. Authors are expected to follow the journal's submission requirements and ensure that all necessary information and supporting documents are prepared before submitting a manuscript.

Important submission information

The online submission and manuscript tracking system is currently under development. The instructions on this page describe the intended submission procedure and should not be treated as confirmation that the submission portal is operational.

1. Before submitting

Authors should first confirm that their manuscript falls within the aims and scope of JPSA. The work should be scientifically relevant to physics and its allied disciplines, including theoretical, experimental, computational and interdisciplinary research.

Before submission, authors should review the journal's Author Guidelines and Manuscript Preparation instructions to ensure that the manuscript is appropriately organised and complete.

2. Originality and exclusive submission

A manuscript submitted to JPSA should represent original scholarly work and should not be under consideration for publication by another journal at the same time.

Authors must disclose substantial overlap with previously published work, related manuscripts and preprints. All sources and reused material should be appropriately acknowledged.

3. Author approval

All listed authors should have made an appropriate contribution to the research, reviewed the final manuscript and approved its submission to the journal.

The corresponding author is responsible for coordinating communication with the editorial office and confirming that all co-authors agree with the submitted version and author list.

4. Files required for submission

Authors should prepare the following materials, as applicable to the manuscript and the requirements of the submission system:

  • Main manuscript: The complete manuscript, including its title, abstract, keywords, main text and references.
  • Figures and tables: Relevant illustrations, tables and captions in suitable formats and resolution.
  • Author information: Full names, institutional affiliations and contact details of all contributors.
  • Declarations: Statements concerning authorship, competing interests, funding, data availability and research ethics, where applicable.
  • Supplementary material: Supporting datasets, computational files, additional figures or other relevant research materials.
  • Permissions: Evidence of permission to reproduce copyrighted figures, tables or other third-party material, where required.

5. Submission of manuscript details

When the submission system becomes available, authors will be expected to provide the relevant manuscript information. This may include the manuscript title, abstract, keywords, article category, author details and institutional affiliations.

The corresponding author should ensure that the information entered into the submission system matches the details in the manuscript.

6. Required declarations

Authors should be prepared to provide declarations relevant to the integrity and transparency of their research. These may include:

  • Confirmation of originality and exclusive submission.
  • Approval of the manuscript by all listed authors.
  • Disclosure of financial and non-financial competing interests.
  • Funding and financial support information.
  • Author contribution statements.
  • Data availability statements, where relevant.
  • Research ethics approval and consent information, where applicable.

7. Initial editorial checks

After a manuscript is submitted, the editorial office may conduct an initial completeness check. This may include verification of the required files, author information, declarations and basic presentation requirements.

If information is missing or corrections are necessary, the corresponding author may be contacted to provide the required material.

8. Editorial assessment and peer review

Submissions that satisfy the initial requirements may proceed to editorial assessment. The editor evaluates the manuscript's relevance, originality and suitability for further consideration.

Manuscripts considered suitable may be sent for external peer review. The resulting editorial decision may involve acceptance, revision or rejection, depending on the assessment.

Submission does not guarantee acceptance or publication.

9. Revised manuscripts

Where revision is requested, authors should carefully address the comments provided by reviewers and editors. A revised manuscript should be accompanied by a point-by-point response explaining the changes made.

If additional time is required to prepare a revision, the corresponding author should communicate with the editorial office before the specified deadline.

10. Correspondence and manuscript tracking

The corresponding author should monitor communications from the editorial office and provide any requested clarifications or additional information within the indicated timeframe.

Once the online manuscript tracking facility is operational, authors may be provided with access to submission status information through the designated system.

11. Publication after acceptance

Manuscripts accepted for publication may proceed to editorial preparation, proofreading and production. Authors may be asked to review proofs and verify the accuracy of the final publication details.

Any applicable publication charges and payment arrangements should be communicated transparently under the journal's approved APC policy.

12. Submission checklist

Before submitting a manuscript, authors should confirm that:

  • The manuscript falls within the scope of JPSA.
  • The manuscript is original and not under consideration elsewhere.
  • All authors have approved the final version.
  • Author names and affiliations are accurate.
  • Figures, tables and references are complete.
  • Required declarations have been prepared.
  • Necessary permissions have been obtained.
  • Supplementary files are ready, where applicable.
